ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a rhombus FGHJ, with vertices approximately F on the left side, G above, H on the right side, and J below. The two diagonals FH and GJ are both drawn and intersect internally at point K; therefore K is located on diagonal FH and also on diagonal GJ. Reasoning: It is known that m∠FJH = 82°, this is the interior angle of the rhombus at vertex J. A rhombus is a parallelogram, so adjacent interior angles are supplementary; therefore the interior angle at vertex H, m∠JHG = 180° − 82° = 98°. The diagonals of a rhombus bisect the two vertex angles they connect; diagonal FH passes through H, and K is on FH, so HK is along HF and bisects the angle ∠JHG at vertex H. Therefore m∠KHJ = 98° ÷ 2 = 49°.

raw_record.question_text:
The diagonals of rhombus FGHJ intersect at K.
If $m\angle FJH = 82$, find $m\angle KHJ$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as rhombus FGHJ with diagonals FH and GJ crossing at K, so K lies on diagonal FH. From the text, use m∠FJH = 82°. In a rhombus, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, so the interior angle at H is m∠JHG = 180° − 82° = 98°. Also, each diagonal of a rhombus bisects the angles at the vertices it connects; therefore diagonal FH bisects ∠JHG. Since HK lies along HF, m∠KHJ = 98°/2 = 49°.

推理：已知 m∠FJH = 82°，这是菱形在顶点 J 处的内角。菱形是平行四边形，所以相邻内角互补，因此顶点 H 处的内角 m∠JHG = 180° − 82° = 98°。菱形的对角线会平分其连接的两个顶点角；对角线 FH 经过 H，且 K 在 FH 上，所以 HK 沿着 HF，平分顶点 H 的角 ∠JHG。因此 m∠KHJ = 98° ÷ 2 = 49°。
